```diff
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {motion} from 'framer-motion'
+ import {cn} from '@/utils'
+ 
+ interface SkeletonLoaderProps {
+   className?: string
+   variant?: 'text' | 'circular' | 'rectangular' | 'card'
+   width?: string | number
+   height?: string | number
+   count?: number
+   animated?: boolean
+ }
+ 
+ const skeletonVariants = {
+   animate: {
+     opacity: [0.4, 0.8, 0.4],
+     transition: {
+       duration: 1.5,
+       repeat: Infinity,
+       ease: 'easeInOut',
+     },
+   },
+ }
+ 
+ export function SkeletonLoader({
+   className,
+   variant = 'rectangular',
+   width,
+   height,
+   count = 1,
+   animated = true,
+ }: SkeletonLoaderProps) {
+   const baseClasses = cn('bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700', animated &amp;&amp; 'animate-pulse', className)
+ 
+   const getVariantClasses = () =&gt; {
+     switch (variant) {
+       case 'text':
+         return 'h-4 rounded'
+       case 'circular':
+         return 'rounded-full'
+       case 'card':
+         return 'h-32 rounded-lg'
+       case 'rectangular':
+       default:
+         return 'rounded'
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   const skeletonItem = (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       className={cn(baseClasses, getVariantClasses())}
+       style={{
+         width: width || '100%',
+         height: height || (variant === 'text' ? '1rem' : '100%'),
+       }}
+       variants={animated ? skeletonVariants : undefined}
+       animate={animated ? 'animate' : undefined}
+     /&gt;
+   )
+ 
+   if (count === 1) {
+     return skeletonItem
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className='space-y-2'&gt;
+       {Array.from({length: count}).map((_, index) =&gt; (
+         &lt;motion.div
+           key={index}
+           initial={{opacity: 0, y: 10}}
+           animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}
+           transition={{delay: index * 0.1}}&gt;
+           {skeletonItem}
+         &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+       ))}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ // Specialized skeleton components for common use cases
+ export function ApplicationSkeleton() {
+   return (
+     &lt;div className='flex flex-col items-center space-y-2 p-2'&gt;
+       &lt;SkeletonLoader variant='rectangular' width={80} height={80} className='rounded-lg' /&gt;
+       &lt;SkeletonLoader variant='text' width={60} height={12} /&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ export function CommandSkeleton() {
+   return (
+     &lt;div className='flex items-center space-x-3 p-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700'&gt;
+       &lt;SkeletonLoader variant='circular' width={24} height={24} /&gt;
+       &lt;div className='flex-1 space-y-1'&gt;
+         &lt;SkeletonLoader variant='text' width='60%' height={16} /&gt;
+         &lt;SkeletonLoader variant='text' width='40%' height={12} /&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ export function ModelSelectionSkeleton() {
+   return (
+     &lt;div className='space-y-3'&gt;
+       &lt;SkeletonLoader variant='text' width='30%' height={20} /&gt;
+       &lt;div className='grid grid-cols-2 gap-2'&gt;
+         {Array.from({length: 4}).map((_, index) =&gt; (
+           &lt;SkeletonLoader key={index} variant='rectangular' height={40} className='rounded-lg' /&gt;
+         ))}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {motion, AnimatePresence} from 'framer-motion'
+ import {CheckCircle, Clock, AlertCircle, Loader2} from 'lucide-react'
+ import {cn} from '@/utils'
+ 
+ interface ProgressIndicatorProps {
+   progress: number
+   status: 'pending' | 'in-progress' | 'completed' | 'error'
+   title: string
+   description?: string
+   className?: string
+   showPercentage?: boolean
+   animated?: boolean
+ }
+ 
+ const statusConfig = {
+   pending: {
+     icon: Clock,
+     color: 'text-gray-400',
+     bgColor: 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800',
+     borderColor: 'border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700',
+   },
+   'in-progress': {
+     icon: Loader2,
+     color: 'text-blue-500',
+     bgColor: 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20',
+     borderColor: 'border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800',
+   },
+   completed: {
+     icon: CheckCircle,
+     color: 'text-green-500',
+     bgColor: 'bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/20',
+     borderColor: 'border-green-200 dark:border-green-800',
+   },
+   error: {
+     icon: AlertCircle,
+     color: 'text-red-500',
+     bgColor: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20',
+     borderColor: 'border-red-200 dark:border-red-800',
+   },
+ }
+ 
+ export function ProgressIndicator({
+   progress,
+   status,
+   title,
+   description,
+   className,
+   showPercentage = true,
+   animated = true,
+ }: ProgressIndicatorProps) {
+   const config = statusConfig[status]
+   const Icon = config.icon
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       className={cn(
+         'relative p-4 rounded-lg border transition-all duration-200',
+         config.bgColor,
+         config.borderColor,
+         className
+       )}
+       initial={animated ? {opacity: 0, y: 10} : undefined}
+       animate={animated ? {opacity: 1, y: 0} : undefined}
+       exit={animated ? {opacity: 0, y: -10} : undefined}&gt;
+       &lt;div className='flex items-start space-x-3'&gt;
+         &lt;div className={cn('flex-shrink-0', config.color)}&gt;
+           &lt;AnimatePresence mode='wait'&gt;
+             {status === 'in-progress' ? (
+               &lt;motion.div
+                 key='loading'
+                 initial={{rotate: 0}}
+                 animate={{rotate: 360}}
+                 transition={{duration: 1, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear'}}&gt;
+                 &lt;Icon className='w-5 h-5' /&gt;
+               &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+             ) : (
+               &lt;motion.div
+                 key='static'
+                 initial={{scale: 0}}
+                 animate={{scale: 1}}
+                 transition={{type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 20}}&gt;
+                 &lt;Icon className='w-5 h-5' /&gt;
+               &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/AnimatePresence&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         &lt;div className='flex-1 min-w-0'&gt;
+           &lt;div className='flex items-center justify-between'&gt;
+             &lt;h4 className='text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white truncate'&gt;{title}&lt;/h4&gt;
+             {showPercentage &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;span className='text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400'&gt;
+                 {Math.round(progress)}%
+               &lt;/span&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           {description &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;p className='mt-1 text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 line-clamp-2'&gt;
+               {description}
+             &lt;/p&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           {/* Progress Bar */}
+           &lt;div className='mt-2'&gt;
+             &lt;div className='w-full bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded-full h-1.5'&gt;
+               &lt;motion.div
+                 className={cn(
+                   'h-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors duration-200',
+                   status === 'completed' &amp;&amp; 'bg-green-500',
+                   status === 'in-progress' &amp;&amp; 'bg-blue-500',
+                   status === 'error' &amp;&amp; 'bg-red-500',
+                   status === 'pending' &amp;&amp; 'bg-gray-400'
+                 )}
+                 initial={animated ? {width: 0} : undefined}
+                 animate={animated ? {width: &#96;${progress}%&#96;} : undefined}
+                 transition={animated ? {duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeOut'} : undefined}
+               /&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ // Specialized progress indicators for common use cases
+ export function TaskProgressIndicator({
+   tasks,
+   onTaskRemove,
+   className,
+ }: {
+   tasks: Array&lt;{
+     id: string
+     type: string
+     status: 'pending' | 'in-progress' | 'completed' | 'error'
+     progress: number
+     title: string
+     description?: string
+   }&gt;
+   onTaskRemove?: (taskId: string) =&gt; void
+   className?: string
+ }) {
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={cn('space-y-2', className)}&gt;
+       &lt;AnimatePresence&gt;
+         {tasks.map((task) =&gt; (
+           &lt;motion.div
+             key={task.id}
+             initial={{opacity: 0, height: 0}}
+             animate={{opacity: 1, height: 'auto'}}
+             exit={{opacity: 0, height: 0}}
+             transition={{duration: 0.2}}&gt;
+             &lt;ProgressIndicator
+               progress={task.progress}
+               status={task.status}
+               title={task.title}
+               description={task.description}
+             /&gt;
+           &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+         ))}
+       &lt;/AnimatePresence&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ export function LoadingSpinner({
+   size = 'md',
+   className,
+ }: {
+   size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
+   className?: string
+ }) {
+   const sizeClasses = {
+     sm: 'w-4 h-4',
+     md: 'w-6 h-6',
+     lg: 'w-8 h-8',
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.div
+       className={cn('flex items-center justify-center', className)}
+       initial={{opacity: 0}}
+       animate={{opacity: 1}}&gt;
+       &lt;motion.div
+         className={cn('text-blue-500', sizeClasses[size])}
+         animate={{rotate: 360}}
+         transition={{duration: 1, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear'}}&gt;
+         &lt;Loader2 className='w-full h-full' /&gt;
+       &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+     &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+   )
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ // Accessibility Styles for LaunchPad
+ // WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance
+ 
+ // Focus Management
+ .focus-visible {
+   outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
+   outline-offset: 2px;
+   border-radius: 4px;
+ }
+ 
+ // High Contrast Mode Support
+ @media (prefers-contrast: high) {
+   .launchpad-overlay {
+     background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95) !important;
+   }
+   
+   .launchpad-container {
+     border: 2px solid #ffffff !important;
+   }
+   
+   .launchpad-button {
+     border: 2px solid currentColor !important;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // Reduced Motion Support
+ @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
+   *,
+   *::before,
+   *::after {
+     animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
+     animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
+     transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
+   }
+   
+   .motion-reduce {
+     animation: none !important;
+     transition: none !important;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // Screen Reader Only Content
+ .sr-only {
+   position: absolute;
+   width: 1px;
+   height: 1px;
+   padding: 0;
+   margin: -1px;
+   overflow: hidden;
+   clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
+   white-space: nowrap;
+   border: 0;
+ }
+ 
+ // Skip Links
+ .skip-link {
+   position: absolute;
+   top: -40px;
+   left: 6px;
+   background: #000;
+   color: #fff;
+   padding: 8px;
+   text-decoration: none;
+   border-radius: 4px;
+   z-index: 1000;
+   
+   &amp;:focus {
+     top: 6px;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // ARIA Live Regions
+ .aria-live {
+   position: absolute;
+   left: -10000px;
+   width: 1px;
+   height: 1px;
+   overflow: hidden;
+ }
+ 
+ // Keyboard Navigation Enhancements
+ .keyboard-nav {
+   &amp;:focus {
+     outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
+     outline-offset: 2px;
+   }
+   
+   &amp;:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
+     outline: none;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // Touch Target Sizes (minimum 44px for touch devices)
+ .touch-target {
+   min-width: 44px;
+   min-height: 44px;
+   display: flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+ }
+ 
+ // Color Contrast Enhancements
+ .high-contrast-text {
+   color: #000000;
+   
+   @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
+     color: #ffffff;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // Semantic HTML Enhancements
+ .semantic-button {
+   cursor: pointer;
+   border: none;
+   background: none;
+   padding: 0;
+   margin: 0;
+   font: inherit;
+   color: inherit;
+   
+   &amp;:focus {
+     outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
+     outline-offset: 2px;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // Loading States for Screen Readers
+ .loading-announcement {
+   @extend .aria-live;
+   aria-live: 'polite';
+ }
+ 
+ // Error States
+ .error-announcement {
+   @extend .aria-live;
+   aria-live: 'assertive';
+ }
+ 
+ // Success States
+ .success-announcement {
+   @extend .aria-live;
+   aria-live: 'polite';
+ }
+ 
+ // Form Accessibility
+ .accessible-form {
+   .form-group {
+     margin-bottom: 1rem;
+   }
+   
+   label {
+     display: block;
+     margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
+     font-weight: 500;
+     color: inherit;
+   }
+   
+   input,
+   textarea,
+   select {
+     width: 100%;
+     padding: 0.75rem;
+     border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
+     border-radius: 0.375rem;
+     font-size: 1rem;
+     line-height: 1.5;
+     
+     &amp;:focus {
+       outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
+       outline-offset: 2px;
+       border-color: #3b82f6;
+     }
+     
+     &amp;:invalid {
+       border-color: #ef4444;
+     }
+   }
+   
+   .error-message {
+     color: #ef4444;
+     font-size: 0.875rem;
+     margin-top: 0.25rem;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // Tab Navigation
+ .tab-list {
+   display: flex;
+   border-bottom: 1px solid #d1d5db;
+   
+   .tab {
+     padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
+     border: none;
+     background: none;
+     cursor: pointer;
+     border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
+     
+     &amp;:focus {
+       outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
+       outline-offset: 2px;
+     }
+     
+     &amp;[aria-selected="true"] {
+       border-bottom-color: #3b82f6;
+       color: #3b82f6;
+     }
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // Modal Accessibility
+ .modal-overlay {
+   position: fixed;
+   top: 0;
+   left: 0;
+   right: 0;
+   bottom: 0;
+   background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
+   display: flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+   z-index: 1000;
+   
+   &amp;:focus {
+     outline: none;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ .modal-content {
+   background: white;
+   padding: 2rem;
+   border-radius: 0.5rem;
+   max-width: 90vw;
+   max-height: 90vh;
+   overflow: auto;
+   
+   &amp;:focus {
+     outline: none;
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // List Accessibility
+ .accessible-list {
+   list-style: none;
+   padding: 0;
+   margin: 0;
+   
+   li {
+     padding: 0.5rem 0;
+     border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6;
+     
+     &amp;:last-child {
+       border-bottom: none;
+     }
+     
+     &amp;:focus-within {
+       background-color: #f9fafb;
+       outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
+       outline-offset: 2px;
+     }
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // Button States
+ .accessible-button {
+   display: inline-flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+   padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
+   border: 1px solid transparent;
+   border-radius: 0.375rem;
+   font-size: 1rem;
+   font-weight: 500;
+   text-decoration: none;
+   cursor: pointer;
+   transition: all 0.2s;
+   
+   &amp;:focus {
+     outline: 2px solid #3b82f6;
+     outline-offset: 2px;
+   }
+   
+   &amp;:disabled {
+     opacity: 0.5;
+     cursor: not-allowed;
+   }
+   
+   &amp;.primary {
+     background-color: #3b82f6;
+     color: white;
+     
+     &amp;:hover:not(:disabled) {
+       background-color: #2563eb;
+     }
+   }
+   
+   &amp;.secondary {
+     background-color: #f3f4f6;
+     color: #374151;
+     
+     &amp;:hover:not(:disabled) {
+       background-color: #e5e7eb;
+     }
+   }
+ } 
```

```diff
+ /* LaunchPad Responsive Design */
+ @media (max-width: 640px) {
+   .launchpad-container {
+     max-width: 95vw;
+     margin: 0 auto;
+     padding: 1rem;
+   }
+

+     font-size: 16px; /* Prevents zoom on iOS */

+ }
+ 
+ @media (max-width: 480px) {
+   .launchpad-grid {
+     grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
+     gap: 0.5rem;
+   }

+     bottom: 1rem;

+ 
+ /* High contrast mode enhancements */
+ @media (prefers-contrast: high) {
+   .launchpad-overlay {

+   }
+   
+   .launchpad-container {
+     border: 2px solid #ffffff !important;

+     border: 2px solid currentColor !important;
+     background-color: #000000 !important;
+     color: #ffffff !important;
+   }
+ }
+

+   }
```
